'Transformational learning is a process whereby individuals are enabled to transform taken-for-granted assumptions and beliefs into more discriminating and flexible ways of thinking'.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
transformative learning is the most challenging and the most effective.
the development of transformative learning approaches in teacher education is a necessary condition for effective professional development.
transformative learning is the ideal, but not the only way for students to learn in the teacher education context.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to be more aware of how we learn and how our learning impacts our teaching.
the integration of the LEARnT model into a teacher education program may be an effective way to support the transformational learning of pre-service teacher education students.
the integration of the reflexive, adaptive, and transformative approaches in teacher education can lead to more effective teaching and learning.
